title: Report Policy Update Clip Fractions
summary: A probability ratio outside the clipping interval does not always change PPO’s objective.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Log densities and ratios are dimensionless; advantage/value/return terms use the caller-fixed reward units.

physical_contract.axes: B rollout streams, T samples; scalar reductions only over Boolean-valid entries
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Ordered transition indices at a fixed caller-declared control interval; terminal events differ from time limits.
physical_contract.batching: B rollout streams, T samples; scalar reductions only over Boolean-valid entries

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded PPO component. Normalization, boundary handling and diagnostic conventions are explicitly supplied; this does not train a complete locomotion policy.
